title: Claude Code Learning Path
summary: Build reliable Claude Code habits through small, observable, and reversible repository tasks.

first-controlled-task.title: Complete a controlled first task
first-controlled-task.objective: Learn the basic interaction loop in a practice repository before increasing scope.
first-controlled-task.risk: Keep the first task local and reversible; do not publish, deploy, or expose credentials.

project-context.title: Establish project context
project-context.objective: Separate durable repository guidance from instructions that belong only to the current task.
project-context.risk: Do not place secrets, personal data, or temporary incident details in persistent project memory.

permissions-and-sandbox.title: Set permissions and sandbox boundaries
permissions-and-sandbox.objective: Recognize the approval boundary for reading, writing, command execution, and external actions.
permissions-and-sandbox.risk: Treat credentials, remote writes, releases, and destructive commands as explicit approval points.

implementation-loop.title: Close the implementation loop
implementation-loop.objective: Move from inspection through a focused change, tests, diff review, and final verification.
implementation-loop.risk: A plausible answer is not completion; verify behavior and inspect the actual diff.

subagents.title: Delegate with subagents
subagents.objective: Use a subagent for an independent task with a narrow ownership boundary and a clear return format.
subagents.risk: Avoid overlapping write ownership and never delegate credentials or ambiguous remote actions.

hooks.title: Automate deterministic checks with hooks
hooks.objective: Run a predictable formatting or validation command at the appropriate lifecycle event.
hooks.risk: Start with an observable, reversible hook and avoid hidden destructive side effects.

mcp.title: Connect a read-only MCP server
mcp.objective: Understand how an MCP server exposes tools and data before granting write capabilities.
mcp.risk: Review authentication, data exposure, tool scope, and untrusted tool output.

delivery-automation.title: Inspect delivery automation
delivery-automation.objective: Understand how Claude Code participates in CI without performing an unauthorized remote write.
delivery-automation.risk: Workflow tokens, repository permissions, publishing, and deployments require explicit authorization.

claude-explore-read-only.title: Explore a repository without writing
claude-explore-read-only.instruction: Ask Claude Code to identify the project structure, active instructions, and primary test command.
claude-explore-read-only.done_when: The response cites concrete files and makes no workspace changes.

claude-verify-first-change.title: Make and verify one small change
claude-verify-first-change.instruction: Choose a reversible edit, request the change, then run the narrowest relevant check.
claude-verify-first-change.done_when: The intended behavior is verified and the final diff contains only the expected edit.

claude-create-project-context.title: Add durable project guidance
claude-create-project-context.instruction: Add one stable, testable repository rule in the project guidance mechanism.
claude-create-project-context.done_when: The rule is concise, scoped correctly, and distinguishable from a one-off task instruction.

claude-verify-context-source.title: Verify context discovery
claude-verify-context-source.instruction: Start a fresh task and ask Claude Code to identify the rule and where it came from.
claude-verify-context-source.done_when: The reported source and effective scope match the repository layout.

claude-classify-operation-boundaries.title: Classify operation boundaries
claude-classify-operation-boundaries.instruction: Sort example actions into read, local write, command execution, external write, and destructive operation.
claude-classify-operation-boundaries.done_when: Each action has a justified permission or approval expectation.

claude-verify-denied-operation.title: Verify a denied operation
claude-verify-denied-operation.instruction: Use a harmless practice case to confirm that a disallowed action is blocked or asks for approval.
claude-verify-denied-operation.done_when: The boundary is observable and no unauthorized side effect occurs.

claude-complete-implementation-loop.title: Complete a focused implementation
claude-complete-implementation-loop.instruction: Have Claude Code inspect, edit, and test one narrowly scoped behavior.
claude-complete-implementation-loop.done_when: The requested behavior works and the relevant check passes.

claude-review-diff-and-tests.title: Review the evidence
claude-review-diff-and-tests.instruction: Inspect the diff and test output, then ask for a regression-focused review.
claude-review-diff-and-tests.done_when: Unexpected changes are removed and any remaining risk is stated explicitly.

claude-delegate-read-only-analysis.title: Delegate a read-only analysis
claude-delegate-read-only-analysis.instruction: Assign a subagent one independent investigation with explicit files, constraints, and output fields.
claude-delegate-read-only-analysis.done_when: The subagent returns grounded findings without editing files.

claude-verify-subagent-boundary.title: Verify subagent ownership
claude-verify-subagent-boundary.instruction: Check that the delegated scope does not overlap another writer or require hidden permissions.
claude-verify-subagent-boundary.done_when: Ownership, evidence, and the next decision are unambiguous.

claude-add-reversible-hook.title: Add a reversible hook
claude-add-reversible-hook.instruction: Configure one local formatting or validation hook in a practice repository.
claude-add-reversible-hook.done_when: The hook is easy to disable and its command is visible in project configuration.

claude-verify-hook-behavior.title: Verify hook behavior
claude-verify-hook-behavior.instruction: Trigger the hook once on a controlled input and inspect its exit status and changes.
claude-verify-hook-behavior.done_when: The hook runs at the intended event and creates no unrelated changes.

claude-connect-read-only-mcp.title: Connect a read-only MCP
claude-connect-read-only-mcp.instruction: Configure a local or test MCP server that exposes only read operations.
claude-connect-read-only-mcp.done_when: Claude Code can list and invoke the expected read-only tool.

claude-audit-mcp-scope.title: Audit the MCP boundary
claude-audit-mcp-scope.instruction: Review the server scope, credentials, returned data, and handling of untrusted output.
claude-audit-mcp-scope.done_when: The available tools and data are no broader than the stated exercise.

claude-inspect-delivery-workflow.title: Inspect a delivery workflow locally
claude-inspect-delivery-workflow.instruction: Read a GitHub Actions workflow and trace its triggers, permissions, inputs, and expected checks.
claude-inspect-delivery-workflow.done_when: The execution path and privileged steps are identified without running a remote workflow.

claude-verify-no-remote-write.title: Confirm the remote-write boundary
claude-verify-no-remote-write.instruction: List every step that could comment, push, publish, deploy, or change remote state.
claude-verify-no-remote-write.done_when: Each remote write has an explicit authorization requirement and none was executed.
